claims: Downtown extension: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM terrain (4 m grid); Lady Bird Lake shoreline = the DEM's hydro-flattened 130.53 m (NAVD88) water surface contoured at +0.3 m on that grid (the City "Lakes" polygon, SOURCE 2003, is fetched only as a cross-check and not used for geometry); City of Austin 2023 building footprints/heights and impervious-cover ground classes; 2017 USGS LiDAR (EPT depth-10 subset) roof tiers, canopy trees and bridge decks; OpenStreetMap (ODbL) outlines/heights for towers completed after the 2023 aerials; authored, photo-referenced landmark profiles. Facades, colours, tower plans inside block outlines and crowns are estimates. Not a survey and not 1:1. Five Capitol-strip (b14) building fragments clipped at z=1536 are replaced by their whole City footprints (stitched across the seam) only when this asset loads.
